name: two-lovers
title: Two Lovers: ruby thread and fairy dust lyrics
origin: NAVAAN, Almost Yours (The Museum of Almosts), Nov 2026

theme_keys.artist: end card top line, e.g. NAVAAN
theme_keys.album_line: e.g. FROM THE ALBUM  AFTER DARK (optional)
theme_keys.release_note: e.g. COMING SOON or OUT NOW (optional)
theme_keys.highlight_words: words that turn ruby when sung, e.g. ["almost", "love"]
theme_keys.snap_at: second (segment time) where the thread snaps; omit for no snap
theme_keys.thread: off to leave the ruby thread out (default on)
theme_keys.end_style: credits for a centred credit card on a dimmed last frame, all serif (default: classic top block)
theme_keys.credits: extra credit lines for end_style credits, split by | (up to 4), e.g. Written and produced by NAVAAN
theme_keys.end_hold: seconds the end card stays after the segment (default 1.5); the song fades out under it
theme_keys.lyrics_y: centre of the lyric block as a fraction of the height: 0.25 top (default), 0.72 lower third, clear of faces
theme_keys.colors: optional overrides: ivory, amber, ruby, brass as [r,g,b]

notes: Every frame is a pure function of time. No follow or subscribe ask on the end card.
